placements.title: Structured checklists replace static documentation to standardize new hire onboarding
placements.frame: How do structured checklists and active shadowing practices replace static documentation in standardizing new hire onboarding?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 articulate the mandatory transition from a legacy static wiki page to the structured first-week Pallasine onboarding checklist covering accounts, pairing rotations, and shadow shifts.
